## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō lǎomǔ nǚ liù yīng jīng* (T560) is a one-fascicle Liú-Sòng translation by Guṇabhadra 求那跋陀羅 ([求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)). The text is part of the "old woman" cluster (cf. [KR6i0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0191), [KR6i0193](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0193)).

**Abstract**

A short sūtra parallel to [KR6i0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0191). The "six heroes" (六英) of the title refers to six elements or six contemplative aspects associated with the old woman's question. Translation dated to Guṇabhadra's productive period (435–468 CE).
